items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Steve Lewis, the first one whom I heard once or twice, but he died shortly after.

ctx.x: Steve Lewis, the first one whom I heard once or twice, but he died shortly after. And then Alexander, Alagretta Alexander was a pianist most of the time after that.
Did most of the piano players around here, I mean, obviously they didn't play on the same style, but did they mostly play the same parts in a band?
